about_the_game:
BUILD IT!

Ever wanted to build a world, build bigger, with better graphics than a 15-year-old game with crappy textures that cost someone 2.5 billion dollars? You found it!

Build your universe, build your house, build your dream house, build anything you want! No weeds will grow on it. No zombies or horses, or spiders will spawn and fall in holes. This is pure building, block-building pleasure.

There are no limits - build into the darkness, as high as you want!

3 different size blocks to use. more colors, more details, ray tracing, anti-aliasing, create your world in more detail than ever before!

We are not in early access - enjoy something that you can pick up and put down as many times as you want. Share your save files with your friends. Build the ultimate world! 

Experience zero gravity, rapid building, the joy of creating something new and unique.

Released Now! Build it, buy this now, own it! Add to your Wishlist!

Start creating, building today! BUILD IT with INCREDIFALL!!!

We have big plans!
